Located in the resort [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Le Yer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]], the '''Triple Nova Casino''' was a noisy [[Casino/Legends|casino]] owned by [[Friizt]], friend of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[A'jidre Skrigatov]], and was known for its extremely gaudy [[Color/Legends|color]] schemes.
